why_not: The fetched text lists tables 226-235 (individual records, unique identifiers, computerised systems, paper or electronic reporting) and defines their indicators but carries none of their values; the only stated figure near the subject is that 3% of facilities have a computer with internet (census of 29 Oct-29 Nov 2023), which is enabling, not an HMIS or EMR aspect.
